svg.title: Mini spider crane — Smákrani á stoðfótum
svg.desc: A compact cabless crane spreads four stabilizer legs beneath a folded telescopic boom and hook.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-mini-spider-crane","label_en":"Mini spider crane","label_is":"Smákrani á stoðfótum","section":"02","category_en":"Lifting, access and site logistics","category_is":"Lyftingar, aðgengi og flutningar á verkstað","batch":1,"tags":["lifting","compact-crane"],"description":"A compact cabless crane spreads four stabilizer legs beneath a folded telescopic boom and hook.","design_note":"Splayed outrigger geometry and the small central carrier distinguish a spider crane from a road truck.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
